questions.question: The fix is committed on branch ci-actionlint-shellcheck (not pushed). How should I handle the repo's backlog/CHANGELOG obligations before pushing?

options.label: Create backlog item (Recommended)
options.description: Add a BACKLOG entry plus trace for this CI change, amend the commit with the item ID, then push. Fully consistent with 'ship complete'. Costs a bit more reading of BACKLOG rules.

options.label: Push as-is, mark [~]
options.description: Push the branch now with no backlog entry and note the gap as [~]. Fast, but the repo temporarily lacks the required BACKLOG/trace record.

options.label: Keep local
options.description: Do not push. You review the diff first and decide on the item ID yourself.

questions.question: The same unquoted '&& break || sleep' retry pattern exists in .github/actions/start-backends/action.yml (3 places). actionlint does not lint composite actions, so it was not flagged. Include it?

options.label: Separate follow-up (Recommended)
options.description: Keep this PR to what actionlint reports; note the composite action as a follow-up backlog item.

options.label: Fix in this branch
options.description: Apply the same quoting/loop fix to action.yml now so all copies of the pattern are consistent.
